items.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Nifty below 24,500, Sensex down 360 pts; Gland Pharma, BSE, Lumax Auto most active
items.description:
Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Indian benchmark indices are trading lower in the opening hour on August 11 amid weak global cues and pressure in banking stocks. At 10:01 hrs IST, the Sensex was down 346.73 points or 0.44 percent at 78,195.71, and the Nifty was down 101.05 points or 0.41 percent at 24,482.75. About 1685 shares advanced, 1704 shares declined, and 172 shares unchanged. HCL Technologies, Eicher Motors, Bajaj Auto, Titan Company and ONGC are among top gainers on the Nifty, while losers are Tata Consumer, Max Healthcare, Nestle, Axis Banka and 
Apollo Hospital.
